title: Review of verb forms (present, past, future)
en:
Choose the form by meaning:

Present Simple — habits, facts · Present Continuous — now, temporary, arrangements · Past Simple — finished time · Past Continuous — in progress in the past · Present Perfect — past → now, experience, result · going to — plans · will — predictions, decisions, promises.

I work for an oil company. I'm preparing an audit this week. I joined in 2019. I've worked here for six years. Next year I'm going to do a course. I think it will help me.
ru: Повторение времён: выбирайте по смыслу — привычка (Present Simple), сейчас / временно / договорённость (Present Continuous), законченное время (Past Simple), процесс в прошлом (Past Continuous), прошлое → сейчас (Present Perfect), план (going to), прогноз / обещание (will).

boss.situation: Write about your career: what you did before, what you have done here, what you are doing now and what you are going to do.
samples: In 2015 I started work as an accountant.
I've worked in internal control for six years.
At the moment I'm preparing for an audit.
Next year I'm going to get a new certificate, and I think it will help my career.

qs.q: I ___ in this company since 2020.
qs.exp: since + up to now → Present Perfect.

qs.q: Look! The manager ___ to the director.
Yesterday I ___ the report to head office.
Next week we ___ an audit. It's already arranged.
She usually ___ to work by bus.
When I arrived, they ___ lunch.
qs.exp: In progress in the past → Past Continuous.

qs.q: I think the new rules ___ problems.
I ___ never been to Europe.
We ___ open a new office next year — that's the plan.
What ___ you do last weekend?
“I have worked here since five years” is correct.
“I was reading when the phone rang” uses Past Continuous + Past Simple.
He ___ (live) in Atyrau all his life.
a: 's lived
has lived

qs.q: Right now I ___ (wait) for a call from Astana.
a: 'm waiting
am waiting

qs.q: She ___ (leave) the company two years ago.
a: left

qs.q: I ___ (not / like) working at weekends.
a: don't like
do not like

qs.q: It's cold. I ___ (close) the window.
a: 'll close
will close

qs.q: While I ___ (drive) to work, I heard the news.
a: was driving

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i have worked here for six years

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we are having a meeting at three today

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what did you do after university

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i am going to take an english course

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she usually starts work at eight

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they were checking the stock when we arrived

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I work here since 2019.”
a: I've worked here since 2019.
I have worked here since 2019.
I have been working here since 2019.
I've been working here since 2019.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Yesterday I have finished the audit.”
a: Yesterday I finished the audit.
I finished the audit yesterday.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Now I write an email.”
a: Now I'm writing an email.
Now I am writing an email.
I'm writing an email now.
I am writing an email now.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “When I came home, my wife cooked dinner, so I waited.”
a: When I came home, my wife was cooking dinner, so I waited.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Tomorrow I meet the auditors at ten.”
a: Tomorrow I'm meeting the auditors at ten.
Tomorrow I am meeting the auditors at ten.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Did you ever be in Almaty?”
a: Have you ever been to Almaty?
Have you ever been in Almaty?

qs.q: Я работаю здесь шесть лет.
a: I've worked here for six years.
I have worked here for six years.
I have been working here for six years.
I've been working here for six years.
qs.exp: Up to now → Present Perfect + for.

qs.q: Я пришёл в компанию в 2019 году.
a: I joined the company in 2019.
I came to the company in 2019.
I started at the company in 2019.
I started working at the company in 2019.
I started working for the company in 2019.

qs.q: Сейчас я готовлюсь к аудиту.
a: Now I'm preparing for an audit.
Now I am preparing for an audit.
I'm preparing for an audit now.
I am preparing for an audit now.
I am preparing for the audit now.
Now I am preparing for the audit.

qs.q: В следующем году я собираюсь пройти курс.
a: Next year I'm going to take a course.
Next year I am going to take a course.
Next year I am going to do a course.
Next year I'm going to do a course.

qs.q: Я думаю, это поможет моей карьере.
a: I think it will help my career.
I think this will help my career.
I think it'll help my career.

qs.q: Когда я пришёл, они обедали.
a: When I came, they were having lunch.
When I arrived, they were having lunch.
When I came in, they were having lunch.

qs.q: Я никогда не был в Европе.
a: I've never been to Europe.
I have never been to Europe.

qs.q: Обычно я начинаю работу в восемь.
a: I usually start work at eight.
Usually I start work at eight.
I usually start work at 8.
I usually start work at eight o'clock.
I usually start working at eight.
